description: This file defines a mock implementation of a cache service for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the CacheService class and provides a static method to retrieve a cache instance, specifically using Symfony's ArrayAdapter.

classes.name: MockCacheService
classes.description: A mock implementation of CacheService used for testing, providing a static method to get a cache adapter.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns an instance of ArrayAdapter cache, optionally namespaced by the provided $namespace parameter.
